mapper.sql: SELECT l.*, CASE WHEN l.instance_id IS NULL THEN 'DRAFT' ELSE i.flow_status END AS flow_status, i.node_name FROM flow_ext_leave l LEFT JOIN flow_instance i ON i.id = l.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE flow_ext_leave SET leave_type = #{request.leaveType}, start_time = #{request.startTime}, end_time = #{request.endTime}, duration_hours = #{request.durationHours}, reason = #{request.reason}, version = version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND applicant_id = #{userId} AND version = #{request.version} AND instance_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM flow_ext_leave WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
